Jwt._comment: Local Dev-Only key. Non-Development startup rejects Dev-Only / Change-In-Production keys — set Jwt__Key via env or user-secrets.

Email._comment: From address for Resend. Set Resend__ApiToken to deliver mail; empty token = log-only stub.

Resend._comment: Set Resend__ApiToken via env / user-secrets. Do not commit real tokens.

MediaStorage._comment: Empty = wwwroot/uploads. On Railway mount a volume and set MediaStorage__RootPath (e.g. /data/uploads) so files survive redeploys.
